Vodka Smash
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, February 14, 2010 - 8:46am

Ingredients




2 quarts Orange juice, [1.75L]
2 cups Vodka, [500mL]
cup Grapefruit juice, [375mL]
cup Lime juice, [175mL]
cup Lemon juice, [175mL]
cup Sugar, [75mL]
1 Orange, thinly sliced
1 Lemon, thinly sliced

Preparation

1 Combine the first 6 ingredients in a punch bowl. Stir until the sugar is dissolved. Chill 1 hour to blend flavours. 2 Float orange and lemon slices on top of the punch. 3 To serve : ladle into ice-filled glasses. 4 Yield : approx. 1 1/2 quarts (3 liters).
